body.p: This application has been reviewed in light of the Non-Final Office Action dated

September 26, 2024. The only outstanding rejection is the obviousness-type double patenting rejection, which alleges that all claims of the present application are obvious over Claims 1-17 of U.S. Patent No. 10,470,826, issued on the great-grandparent of the present application, in view of Claims 1-7 of U.S. Patent No. 10,918,446, issued on the grandparent of the present application. While Applicant does not concede the propriety of this rejection, Applicant submits herewith a Terminal Disclaimer with respect to the '826 great-grandparent Patent, which is submitted to obviate the obviousness-type double patenting rejection. Accordingly, all claims are believed to be allowable.
In view of the foregoing remarks and the Terminal Disclaimer submitted herewith, Applicant respectfully requests the allowance of the present application.

Should the Examiner have any issues concerning this reply or any other outstanding issues remaining in this application, the favor of a telephone call to Applicant's undersigned attorney is respectfully requested in order to expedite prosecution.
20609 GORDON PARK SQUARE, SUITE 150 ASHBURN, VA 20147
